# openCenter CLI repository navigation

This is a concise, repository-local map for code-oriented readers and language
models. It is not the reader-facing documentation index, a generated command
reference, or evidence that a hosted documentation site is published.

## Navigation

- [Project entry point](README.md) — project summary and source-build quick start.
- [Reader-facing documentation index](docs/index.md) — lifecycle-oriented
  documentation source index.
- [Documentation maintenance guide](docs/README.md) — metadata, classification,
  links, and checks.
- [CLI command reference](docs/reference/cli-commands.md) — built-in command
  groups and flags.
- [Configuration schema](docs/reference/configuration-schema.md) — schema fields
  and validation surface.
- [Provider reference](docs/reference/providers.md) — current provider boundary.
- [File locations](docs/reference/file-locations.md) — configuration and state
  paths.
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md) — terminology used by the repository docs.
- [Error codes](docs/reference/error-codes.md) — the `E*` codes registered in
  `internal/ui/error_formatter.go`, and which of them the CLI actually prints.
- [Release notes](docs/release/index.md) — release notes index, newest first.

## Source-oriented maps

For package responsibilities and change boundaries, start at the internal
[CODEMAPS index](docs/CODEMAPS/INDEX.md). Those maps are repository-internal
explanations, not operator documentation:

- [CLI commands map](docs/CODEMAPS/cli-commands.md)
- [Cluster lifecycle map](docs/CODEMAPS/cluster-lifecycle.md)
- [Configuration system map](docs/CODEMAPS/config-system.md)
- [GitOps engine map](docs/CODEMAPS/gitops-engine.md)
- [Providers map](docs/CODEMAPS/providers.md)
- [Secrets management map](docs/CODEMAPS/secrets-management.md)
- [Runtime and local development map](docs/CODEMAPS/runtime-extensions-and-local-development.md)

## Source of truth pointers

- Cobra command registration and help text: `cmd/`.
- Configuration types, defaults, and validation: `internal/config/` and
  `schema/`.
- Provider lifecycle implementations: `internal/cloud/` and `internal/cluster/`.
- GitOps rendering and ownership: `internal/gitops/`.
- Secret and SOPS/Age workflows: `internal/secrets/`, `internal/sops/`, and
  `internal/secretartifacts/`.
- Tool versions and task commands: `.mise.toml`.

When exact behavior matters, inspect those sources and the relevant tests, then
use the linked reference page for reader-facing context. The per-command pages
are regenerated with `mise run docs-gen`; this file is maintained manually and
should remain navigation rather than a second command catalog.
